claims.statement: Most Polish taxpayers had to issue through KSeF from 1 April 2026, while firms at or below PLN 10,000 in monthly invoiced gross sales have only a temporary exception through 2026.
KSeF was already processing at scale by March 2026: the Ministry reported more than 345,000 issuers and 87 million invoices in the first two months.
No sanctions for KSeF usage errors are imposed for 2026, weakening an immediate penalty-avoidance purchase trigger.
Free Ministry applications cover issuance, receipt, viewing, status, UPO and permission management, so basic compliance has a free workaround.
Acceptance protocols, contracts and unstructured evidence cannot be sent as KSeF invoice attachments, establishing a separate upstream evidence-management job.
KSeF exposes a documented production API, test environments, OpenAPI contract and reference libraries, so implementation is accessible to incumbents and entrants.
Production authentication depends on taxpayer-granted rights, and organisations remain responsible for certificate distribution, use and revocation.
Serwis Pro offers the same broad field-to-invoice journey for target trades, including photos, signed protocols offline, invoices, FA(3) transmission and UPO.
Majsta offers signatures, progress evidence, acceptance protocols and KSeF at PLN 39-89 monthly, materially contradicting the original assumed price and scarcity.
A defensible wedge must be contract-specific invoice-release logic and measured dispute or delay reduction, not generic artifact capture or KSeF submission.
The official construction-enterprise share is only a broad denominator and does not validate a 4,700-customer reachable market in relevant trades.
Paid willingness to buy contract-specific gating, representative exception frequency and measurable invoice-cycle improvement are unknown.
Bookkeeping-office, wholesaler and field-software distribution commitments, CAC and churn are unknown.

contrary_evidence: Free government applications cover the core tax-document workflow.
The Ministry suspended error sanctions for 2026.
Two current Polish products cover the upstream signature/protocol-to-KSeF path.
One direct competitor publicly prices the workflow at PLN 39-89 per month.
The KSeF API and integration libraries are public.
